name: i.safe MOBILE IS440.1
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS440.1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) 5G push-to-talk radio from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx, and for Class I Division 1 in North America. It runs ISM-OS 14, with 5G and a user-replaceable battery.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db

certification.northAmerica: Class I, Division 1, Groups ABCD, T4; Class II, Division 1, Groups EFG, 135°C; Class III (QPS Certificate of Compliance LR3081-6R2, 30 Sep 2025; CSA C22.2 No. 60079-0/-11, UL 60079-0/-11)

safety.conditions: EPS 23 ATEX 1 249 X / IECEx EPS 23.0069X: battery may be charged and replaced outside hazardous areas only; protect from high-energy impacts, excessive UV light and high electrostatic charge processes; USB-C cover must be securely closed in hazardous areas; Ta −20 °C to +55 °C. QPS LR3081-6R2 (North America) adds: recharge only outside hazardous areas using the i.safe PROTECTOR 2.0 USB-C cable; nano-SIM cards meeting Uo 5.88 V, Co 40 µF, Lo 1 µH. Only approved accessories on the 8-pin ISM interface (IS-HS3A.1, IS-HDHS2x.1, IS-PTTB2A.1 with or without IS-HDHS1x.1).

specs.gnss: GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, A-GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo (web page also lists NavIC, QZSS, SBAS)
specs.keys: Dedicated PTT; programmable red key (SOS/LWP); channel selector; M1/M2 keys
specs.accessories: 8-pin ISM interface (audio accessories); USB-C; charging contacts
specs.apps: App World (curated PTT and MDM apps)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Built in (dedicated PTT key + PoC apps)

variants.name: IS440.M1
variants.description: Mining version, rated for Group I (Ex ia) as well as Zone 1/21 (Ex ib).
variants.marking: I M1 Ex ia I Ma

variants.name: EdgeOne
variants.description: The IS440.1 is also certified under the name EdgeOne, with the same certificates.

unconfirmed.specs.dimensionsMm: From i.safe MOBILE's datasheet; its web page gives a width of 70 mm.

limitations: T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
